recipes.title: Approval remote
recipes.description: Review a versioned proposal, approve or request changes, and follow the outcome.
permissions: Microphone is optional for dictating a revision.
recipes.request: Prepare one small proposal for me to review. Wait for my versioned approval before doing the work.

preview.alt: Actual local preview of the approval remote starter

recipes.title: Field notebook
recipes.description: Keep durable observations with photos, reviewed locations, interpretations, search and export.
permissions: Photos are optional; choose a file or allow the camera.
Location is requested only when I choose Add this place.
recipes.request: Start a notebook for observations. Help me add a note, optionally attach a reviewed photo or location, and interpret it without losing my original observation.

preview.alt: Actual local preview of the field notebook starter

recipes.title: Hands-free task guide
recipes.description: Follow stable steps, hear instructions, attach evidence and resume from saved checkpoints.
permissions: Voice recognition, camera, recording and keeping the screen awake are optional and enabled on the device.
recipes.request: Guide me through a small task one step at a time. Keep stable checkpoints, offer spoken instructions and let me review evidence before sending it.

preview.alt: Actual local preview of the hands-free task guide starter

recipes.title: Multi-device workshop
recipes.description: Give devices explicit purposes, share a camera view and annotated steps, and move audio focus.
permissions: Each participating device signs in or uses an owner-created display link.
Camera access begins only after an explicit tap; captured photos are shared, live video stays on the device.
recipes.request: Help me use a phone, controller and display for one shared task. Give devices clear purposes and advance from explicit completion receipts.

preview.alt: Actual local preview of the multi-device workshop starter

recipes.title: Hardware experiment companion
recipes.description: Plot serial or simulated readings, record interventions, interpret a run and export its report.
permissions: Simulation works without a device permission.
A real instrument needs a supported browser and an explicit Serial device choice; this page only reads it.
recipes.request: Help me run a small measurement experiment. Start with clearly labelled simulated readings, then let me connect a supported instrument, record interventions and export the run.

preview.alt: Actual local preview of the hardware experiment companion starter

recipes.title: Facilitated group session
recipes.description: Collect private participant answers and publish a deliberately shared group summary.
permissions: Participants sign in; only their own private answers are loaded.
The shared display receives the deliberately published prompt and summary.
recipes.request: Help me facilitate a small group session. Collect private participant answers and let me review the summary before sharing it with the group.

preview.alt: Actual local preview of the facilitated group session starter
